title: The Singing Sand Dunes of Qatar

scenes.text: Visitors hear dunes humming up to 105 decibels
The phenomenon occurs in the Khor Al Adaid desert, a protected area near the southern coast of Qatar
Researchers measured frequencies between 70 Hz and 110 Hz during the sound events
Early 1970s film footage captures the dunes' resonant tones
scenes.archive_query: Khor Al Adaid singing dunes 1970s site:commons.wikimedia.org

scenes.text: Scientists attribute the sound to sand grain size and movement, but exact mechanics stay debated
scenes.label: MYSTERY SOUND
scenes.sub: Granular physics still not fully understood
